issue.title: Retire commit_drain_skips_imports
issue.description: The post-commit agent-hood publication drain publishes the committing agent's hood without running the full-sync import-integration pass; imports happen only in the explicit sase agent sync path.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Post-commit publications have run with imports skipped long enough to show no missing-foreign-hood regressions, and the pending agents-sync import-leg redesign has settled whether the import leg survives at all.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: The post-commit publication drain runs integrate_agent_imports_with_receipts over the whole agents sidecar before publishing, as before.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: The post-commit agent-hood publication drain publishes the committing agent's hood without running the full-sync import-integration pass; imports happen only in the explicit sase agent sync path.

payload.entry: Closed with import-engine deletion: the off branch depended on integrate_agent_imports_with_receipts, and commit publication now runs without the removed import integration pass.
